# Semantic Kernel Plugin Skill

## Goal
Create reusable and testable Semantic Kernel plugins.

## Workflow
1. Define plugin responsibility
2. Create strongly typed models
3. Add plugin methods
4. Add logging
5. Add validation
6. Add retry policies
7. Add unit tests

## Rules
- Keep plugins small and focused
- Avoid prompt duplication
- Separate orchestration from plugins
- Prefer deterministic outputs
- Centralize prompt templates

## Checklist
- Plugin isolated
- Models typed
- Logging added
- Retry handling added
- Tests added
